name: bell
description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The compact top hanger and body match the visible Regular 1.70 Outline. The Filled clapper is a solid rounded half-disc: its upper edge closes the opening, while its lower curve and round outside corners follow the Regular Outline exterior. The closed clapper interior is united with its 0.85-unit outer expansion, leaving no U-shaped recess. Body/clapper separation and visible vertical bounds y=1.9..22.1 are retained. This intentional solid interior follows the Filled body treatment; it is not a counter. Fixed fill-only geometry; other Outline weights may differ. Pending owner review.

review.note: Owner reopened Bell review after noticing the hollow-looking Filled clapper. The Filled clapper is now solid and awaits visual review; Outline geometry is unchanged.
